t: Arienzo parish registers, Collegiate Church of Sant'Andrea
d: Baptisms 1672–1738 and 1761–1837; Marriages 1754–1900; Deaths 1733–1888. Digitised by FamilySearch and searchable by handwriting recognition in the collection Italy, Campania, Religious, from 1551 to 1975.

t: Italy, Caserta, Santa Maria Capua Vetere, Civil Registration (Tribunale), 1866–1929
d: FamilySearch collection 2043630. The tribunal copies of the civil registers — births, marriages, deaths, marriage banns and the marriage supplements that quote earlier records.
